description: Thursday 13:35: Darnell Washington, who was at Bluff City Welding Supply's counter for his own acetylene, emails Reggie, in a new thread, a photo of counter quote No. 20871 as Ray Odom revised it there: the 75/25 cylinder exchange struck from 41.00 to 44.50 each (89.00), a hazmat handling line of 18.50 added and the total struck from 766.30 to 791.80, 'cyl. price up 12/9 - RO'. The body names only the attachment, which lands in the Mail app's attachment store. Unread. Nothing announces it. Thursday 13:05: Darnell asks whether the kids are coming to his Christmas party on the 19th (Tasha wants to know), in a WhatsApp message to Reggie (unannounced). Thursday 14:40: Coach Banks asks him to help hang the new batting cage nets on Sunday (after church), in a WhatsApp message to Reggie (unannounced).
